news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics to Announce Financial Results for the Second Quarter on Thursday, August 13, 2026, After Close of U.S.-Based Financial Markets
news.summary: Nektar announced it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results on August 13, 2026 after U.S. markets close. President and CEO Howard Robin will host a conference call at 5:00 p.m. ET to review results, including progress on rezpegaldesleukin.

news.headline: Is Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Undervalued On Its Phase 3 Rezpegaldesleukin Launch?
news.summary: The analysis weighs whether Nektar's stock remains undervalued after the company launched its Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin, considering the drug's clinical profile against the company's current market valuation.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NASDAQ:NKTR) Coverage Initiated at Canaccord Genuity Group
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity analyst Edward Nash initiated coverage of Nektar Therapeutics with a Buy rating and a $153 price target, citing the rezpegaldesleukin opportunity in atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Novel Regulatory T-Cell Biologic Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar initiated the first two of three planned global registrational Phase 3 trials (ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2), each enrolling 510 patients aged 12 and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis who have not previously used biologics or systemic JAK inhibitors. A third trial, ZENITH AD-3, for patients with prior biologic/JAK experience, is set to begin in September 2026 to complete the registrational program spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Climbs As Immunology Sentiment Improves
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped roughly 10.65% on July 2, 2026, moving from the mid-$50s to around $71, amid improving investor sentiment toward the immunology sector and momentum ahead of the ZENITH AD Phase 3 launch.

news.headline: What a $1.2 Million Insider Sale Means for Nektar With Shares Up 160% This Past Year
news.summary: Nektar CEO Howard Robin sold 20,000 shares in open-market transactions on June 16-17 for about $1.22 million, roughly 26.6% of his direct holdings, under a pre-set Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The disclosure comes as NKTR shares have risen approximately 160% over the trailing year amid optimism around rezpegaldesleukin's advancement into Phase 3.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Nektar will report second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close and host a conference call at 5:00 p.m. ET led by CEO Howard Robin, with updates expected on ZENITH AD Phase 3 enrollment progress and cash runway.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: The third global registrational trial, ZENITH AD-3, enrolling atopic dermatitis patients with prior biologic or JAK inhibitor experience, is set to begin in September 2026, completing the three-trial ZENITH AD Phase 3 program that began with AD-1 and AD-2 in July 2026.

catalysts.label: NKTR-0165 preclinical data presentation
catalysts.detail: Preclinical data from the NKTR-0165 (TNFR2 agonist antibody) program targeting tissue-specific regulatory T cells is expected to be presented at a scientific conference in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to start a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, building on positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept data and the drug's FDA Fast Track designation in this indication.

catalysts.label: Type 1 diabetes Phase 2 (TrialNet) initial data
catalysts.detail: Initial data from the TrialNet-sponsored Phase 2 study of rezpegaldesleukin in new-onset Type 1 diabetes mellitus is expected in 2027.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 initial readout
catalysts.detail: Initial top-line results from the ZENITH AD Phase 3 registrational program in atopic dermatitis are expected around mid-2028, with a BLA submission targeted for 2029 per company guidance given at trial initiation.

pulse: Nektar remains in a pivotal build-up phase, having launched the first two global registrational Phase 3 trials (ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2) for rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis on July 21, 2026, with a third trial (AD-3) slated to start in September 2026 and a separate alopecia areata Phase 3 program still to follow. The stock has rallied roughly 160% over the past year on optimism about REZPEG's differentiated Treg-biology profile, reinforced by Canaccord Genuity initiating coverage with a Buy rating and $153 target on July 22, even as CEO Howard Robin trimmed a portion of his personal stake in mid-June under a pre-set trading plan. Attention now turns to Q2 2026 earnings on August 13, where investors will look for updates on trial enrollment pace, cash runway, and pipeline milestones including NKTR-0165 preclinical data expected later this year.
